_note: The profile screen and the instance lock (docs/PROFILES.md; shared/profiles.rs rules, app/instance.rs start, ui/profile_screen.rs drawing). A running game rewrites instance.lock in its profile folder every `heartbeat_seconds`; a lock not rewritten for `stale_after_seconds` (or whose process is gone, where the system can say) is stale and the profile is free. `shift_hold_seconds`: how long after the title first shows a held SHIFT still opens the profile screen. `lock_refresh_seconds`: how often the profile screen rereads the index and the locks. `last_used` must contain {time}; `delete_title` and `in_use_note` must contain {name}. `errors` has one line per refusal (shared/profiles.rs ProfileError::key).
title: CHOOSE A PROFILE
